_note: OPTIONAL. The monitor runs with zero configuration — you do NOT need this file. Copy it to config.json ONLY if you want project pin-scanning, desktop notifications, or webhook delivery. Never commit your real config.json (it may contain local paths/secrets); it is gitignored.
_subscribers_note: For MULTIPLE alert destinations with per-destination level filtering, create a gitignored subscribers.json (copy subscribers.example.json) — see README 'Subscribers' section. It is separate from config.json and supports env-var indirection so webhook secrets stay out of the file.
